mapper.sql: id, tenant_id, order_id, order_no, allocation_type, target_member_id, target_user_id, target_agent_id, original_amount, current_amount, settled_amount, reversed_amount, status, settle_time, create_time, update_time
mapper.select: SELECT FROM dms_order_balance_allocation WHERE order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY CASE allocation_type WHEN 'PRODUCT_COST' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, id
SELECT FROM dms_order_balance_allocation WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND allocation_type = #{allocationType} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM dms_order_balance_allocation WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT o.id FROM dms_shop_order o WHERE o.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND o.pay_time IS NOT NULL AND o.status IN (1, 2, 3) AND ( NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM dms_order_balance_allocation a WHERE a.order_id = o.id AND a.allocation_type = 'PRODUCT_COST' ) OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM dms_order_balance_allocation a WHERE a.order_id = o.id AND a.allocation_type = 'REMAINDER' ) ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM dms_bonus_calculation_task task WHERE task.order_id = o.id AND task.status IN (0, 1, 3) ) ORDER BY o.pay_time, o.id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT a.id FROM dms_order_balance_allocation a INNER JOIN dms_shop_order o ON o.id = a.order_id WHERE o.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND a.status = 0 AND a.current_amount > 0 AND o.status = 3 AND o.receive_time IS NOT NULL AND o.receive_time <= #{receivedCutoff} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM dms_shop_after_sale sale WHERE sale.order_id = a.order_id AND sale.status = 0 ) ORDER BY o.receive_time, a.order_id, CASE a.allocation_type WHEN 'PRODUCT_COST' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dms_order_balance_allocation (tenant_id, order_id, order_no, allocation_type, target_member_id, target_user_id, target_agent_id, original_amount, current_amount, settled_amount, reversed_amount, status) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{orderId}, #{orderNo}, #{allocationType}, #{targetMemberId}, #{targetUserId}, #{targetAgentId}, #{originalAmount}, #{currentAmount}, #{settledAmount}, #{reversedAmount}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE dms_order_balance_allocation SET current_amount = #{currentAmount}, status = #{status}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND settled_amount = 0

UPDATE dms_order_balance_allocation SET settled_amount = #{settledAmount}, settle_time = #{settleTime}, status = #{status}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 0 AND settled_amount = 0
UPDATE dms_order_balance_allocation SET current_amount = #{currentAmount}, reversed_amount = #{reversedAmount}, status = #{status}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
